title: Which Metadata Matters for LLM Tool Selection in MCP? Evidence from Controlled Factor-Level Interventions
title_zh: 哪些元数据对 MCP 中 LLM 工具的选择至关重要？来自受控因子层级干预的证据

paragraphs.en: In Model Context Protocol (MCP) systems, LLMs select tools from metadata rather than from their implementations. Names and descriptions summarize what a tool does, while the parameter schema specifies the fields a tool accepts and how they are organized. Our analysis of metadata for 367,174 MCP tools reveals substantial schema variation among functionally similar tools. Many of these tools share names and similar descriptions but expose different parameter schemas. This raises a key question: can parameter-schema differences influence tool selection before any call is made? We study this question through controlled metadata interventions across five LLMs and five tasks. Each comparison changes exactly one metadata factor (server name, tool name, description, or parameter schema) while keeping the others fixed. We balance tool positions and use conditional logistic regression to estimate position-adjusted effects. We find that: (1) parameter-schema changes produce the largest and most consistent selection shifts among the tested interventions. Models tend to favor separate top-level parameters over grouped or composite forms. (2) Descriptions that explain parameters also tend to increase selection, while name effects are weaker and less consistent. (3) Targeted comparisons show that schema effects depend on the specific parameter names and on how the request represents the same information. When only one schema satisfies an explicit request requirement, all five models select the compatible tool despite position preferences. These results show that parameter schemas influence not only how tools are called, but also whether they are selected. For MCP developers and evaluators, schema design and tool ordering can therefore affect which implementation is invoked even when functionality is unchanged.
paragraphs.zh: 在模型上下文协议（MCP）系统中，大型语言模型（LLM）会根据元数据而非工具的实际实现来选择工具。 名称和描述总结了工具的功能，而参数模式则定义了工具接受的字段及其组织方式。 我们对 367,174 个 MCP 工具的元数据进行分析后发现，功能相似的工具之间在参数模式上存在显著差异。 这些工具中许多共享相同的名称和相似描述，但暴露的参数模式却各不相同。 这引出了一个关键问题：在发出任何调用之前，参数模式的差异是否会影响工具的选择？ 我们通过五种大型语言模型（LLM）和五个任务，采用受控的元数据干预方法来研究这一问题。 每次比较仅改变一个元数据因素（服务器名称、工具名称、描述或参数模式），其余因素保持不变。 我们对工具的位置进行了平衡处理，并使用条件逻辑回归来估计经过位置调整的影响。 我们的发现表明：（1）在测试的干预措施中，参数模式的变更对工具选择产生的影响最大且最一致。 模型倾向于偏好独立的顶层参数，而非分组或复合形式的参数。 （2）对参数进行解释的描述也有助于提升工具被选中的概率，而名称的影响则较弱且不够稳定。 （3）针对性比较显示，参数模式的影响取决于具体的参数名称以及请求中呈现相同信息的方式。 当只有一个参数模式满足明确请求的要求时，所有五种模型都会选择兼容的工具，无论其位置偏好如何。 这些结果表明，参数模式不仅影响工具的调用方式，也影响工具是否会被选中。 因此，对于 MCP 开发者和评估者而言，参数模式的设计和工具排序可能会影响最终被调用的实现，即使功能本身没有变化。

paragraphs.en: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) lets an application connect to tools from many independently developed MCP servers ( Model Context Protocol, 2026a ; Model Context Protocol, 2026b ) . As tool ecosystems grow, an LLM may need to choose among tools with overlapping functionality. The model does not observe a tool’s implementation directly; it sees an interface representation consisting of a server name, a tool name, a description, and a parameter schema (Figure 1 b). Which tool the model selects determines which implementation runs, so the choice matters for the reliability of tool-using systems, for developers whose servers compete to be used, and for anyone who might edit tool metadata to steer the model.
paragraphs.zh: 模型上下文协议（MCP）允许应用程序连接到许多独立开发的 MCP 服务器提供的工具（Model Context Protocol，2026a；Model Context Protocol，2026b）。 随着工具生态系统的发展，大型语言模型可能需要从功能重叠的工具中进行选择。 模型不会直接观察工具的实现方式；它看到的是一种接口表示形式，包括服务器名称、工具名称、描述和参数模式（图 1b）。 模型选择哪个工具决定了哪个实现会被执行，因此这一选择对于使用工具的系统可靠性、其服务器相互竞争被使用的开发者，以及任何可能编辑工具元数据以引导模型的用户而言都至关重要。

paragraphs.en: These metadata factors are designed for different purposes. Names and descriptions explicitly summarize what a tool does, whereas the parameter schema is primarily designed to specify how the tool should be invoked. The MCP ecosystem shows why this distinction deserves attention. In metadata for 367,174 MCP tools ( Li and Gao, 2026 ) , tools with the same function often share a name and a similar description but differ widely in their parameters: the 169 records named send_email use 78 distinct parameter sets (Figure 1 a). From their names and descriptions, these tools are easy to recognize as doing the same thing; they differ mainly in details intended for invocation, such as whether the recipient field is called to or recipient_id (Appendix A.2 ). This raises the possibility that such details already influence which tool is selected, before any call is made. We ask whether they do, and how their influence compares with that of names and descriptions.
paragraphs.zh: 这些元数据因素是为不同目的而设计的。 名称和描述明确总结了工具的功能，而参数模式则主要用于指定工具的调用方式。 MCP 生态系统表明，这种区分值得重视。 在 367,174 个 MCP 工具的元数据中（Li 和 Gao，2026），功能相同的工具通常共享名称和相似的描述，但其参数却差异显著：名为 send_email 的 169 条记录使用了 78 种不同的参数组合（图 1a）。 从名称和描述来看，这些工具很容易被识别为执行相同操作的工具；它们的主要差异在于调用相关的细节，例如收件人字段是称为 to 还是 recipient_id（附录 A.2）。 这引发了一个可能性：在尚未进行任何调用之前，这类细节可能已经影响了工具的选择。 我们想知道这种影响是否存在，以及它与名称和描述所带来的影响相比如何。

paragraphs.en: Prior work has shown that tool selection can be biased ( Blankenstein et al., 2026 ) and that edits to tool descriptions can shift which tool a model prefers ( Faghih et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026c ) ; related work has also documented quality problems in MCP tool descriptions ( Hasan et al., 2026 ) . The role of parameter schemas has received substantially less attention, particularly in controlled comparisons that isolate schema changes from changes to names and descriptions.

paragraphs.en: Ecosystem data alone cannot answer this question, because tools that differ in their schemas usually differ in other metadata as well. We therefore intervene directly. For five common tasks, we construct tool variants that differ in exactly one metadata field, using forms observed in the ecosystem, and present them together as candidates for the same user requests. Because candidate order can itself affect selection, we balance tool positions and adjust for position with a conditional logit model ( Train, 2003 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 仅凭生态系统数据无法回答这个问题，因为schema不同的工具通常在其他元数据方面也存在差异。 因此，我们直接进行干预。 针对五个常见任务，我们构建了在恰好一个元数据字段上存在差异的工具变体，这些变体基于在生态系统中观察到的形式，并将它们作为同一用户请求的候选选项一并呈现。 由于候选项的顺序本身可能影响选择，我们通过条件逻辑模型（Train, 2003）来平衡工具的位置并调整位置的影响。

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we make three contributions.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了三项贡献。

paragraphs.en: First , we introduce a controlled framework for studying MCP tool selection. It spans four metadata factors, five tasks, five LLMs, and candidate sets of two, three, and five tools. Each comparison changes a single field, reuses the same requests, and balances candidate positions, isolating the effect of each tested edit.
paragraphs.zh: 首先，我们提出一个受控框架，用于研究 MCP 工具的选择问题。 该框架涵盖四个元数据因素、五个任务、五种大型语言模型，以及包含两种、三种和五种工具的候选集。 每次比较仅改变一个字段，重复使用相同的请求，并平衡候选工具的位置，从而隔离每次测试性修改的影响。

sents.en: First , we introduce a controlled framework for studying MCP tool selection.
sents.zh: 首先，我们提出一个受控框架，用于研究 MCP 工具的选择问题。

sents.en: It spans four metadata factors, five tasks, five LLMs, and candidate sets of two, three, and five tools.
sents.zh: 该框架涵盖四个元数据因素、五个任务、五种大型语言模型，以及包含两种、三种和五种工具的候选集。

sents.en: Each comparison changes a single field, reuses the same requests, and balances candidate positions, isolating the effect of each tested edit.
sents.zh: 每次比较仅改变一个字段，重复使用相同的请求，并平衡候选工具的位置，从而隔离每次测试性修改的影响。

paragraphs.en: Second , we find that schema edits produce the largest and most consistent shifts in selection among the tested edits. We distinguish three kinds of schema edits: renaming parameters, grouping parameters into a single object, and splitting a composite input into separate factors. Models tend to favor separate top-level fields, such as owner and repo rather than a single owner/repo string, and naming effects depend strongly on the particular names being compared. Descriptions that explain parameters also tend to increase selection, whereas the effects of server and tool names are weaker and vary across models. When candidates differ only in their names, models often pick the first-listed tool.
paragraphs.zh: 其次，我们发现，在测试的所有编辑中，模式编辑对选择产生的影响最大且最一致。 我们将模式编辑分为三种类型：重命名参数、将参数分组为单个对象，以及将复合输入拆分为独立因子。 模型倾向于偏好独立的顶层字段（例如 owner 和 repo），而不是单一的 owner/repo 字符串；而命名效应则强烈依赖于所比较的具体名称。 对参数进行解释的描述也有助于提升被选中的概率，而服务器和工具名称的影响则较弱，且因模型不同而异。 当候选项仅在名称上存在差异时，模型通常会选择列表中排在首位的工具。

sents.zh: 对参数进行解释的描述也有助于提升被选中的概率，而服务器和工具名称的影响则较弱，且因模型不同而异。

sents.en: When candidates differ only in their names, models often pick the first-listed tool.

paragraphs.en: Third , we examine when and why schema effects arise. Renaming to to recipient_id reduces a tool’s selection rate to 1–10% across models, whereas renaming it to receiver , a word absent from the requests, leaves the tool competitive (35–51%). The effect therefore does not require word overlap with the request, and is consistent with recipient_id signaling an identifier rather than an email address. The preference for separate owner and repo fields weakens for every model, and reverses for one, when the same request gives the repository as a single owner/repo path. Finally, when a request asks for a CC recipient that only one schema can accept, all five models select that tool, even when it is listed second. Together, these results indicate that models use schema information to judge whether a tool fits a request during selection, rather than only to format arguments after selection.
paragraphs.zh: 第三，我们研究了模式效应何时以及为何会出现。 将其重命名为 recipient_id 后，工具的选择率在各类模型中降至 1–10%，而将其重命名为 receiver（一个请求中未出现的词）则使该工具保持竞争力（35–51%）。 因此，这种效应并不要求与请求中的词语重叠，并且与 recipient_id 表示标识符而非电子邮件地址的情况一致。 当相同的请求以 owner/repo 单一路径提供仓库时，所有模型对单独设置 owner 和 repo 字段的偏好都会减弱，其中一个模型甚至会反转这一偏好。 最后，当请求要求一个 CC 收件人且只有一个模式可以接受时，所有五个模型都会选择该工具，即使它排在第二位。 综合来看，这些结果表明，模型在选择工具时会利用模式信息来判断某个工具是否适合当前请求，而不仅仅是在选择后用于格式化参数。

sents.en: Third , we examine when and why schema effects arise.
sents.zh: 第三，我们研究了模式效应何时以及为何会出现。

sents.en: Renaming to to recipient_id reduces a tool’s selection rate to 1–10% across models, whereas renaming it to receiver , a word absent from the requests, leaves the tool competitive (35–51%).
sents.zh: 将其重命名为 recipient_id 后，工具的选择率在各类模型中降至 1–10%，而将其重命名为 receiver（一个请求中未出现的词）则使该工具保持竞争力（35–51%）。

sents.en: The effect therefore does not require word overlap with the request, and is consistent with recipient_id signaling an identifier rather than an email address.
sents.zh: 因此，这种效应并不要求与请求中的词语重叠，并且与 recipient_id 表示标识符而非电子邮件地址的情况一致。

sents.en: The preference for separate owner and repo fields weakens for every model, and reverses for one, when the same request gives the repository as a single owner/repo path.
sents.zh: 当相同的请求以 owner/repo 单一路径提供仓库时，所有模型对单独设置 owner 和 repo 字段的偏好都会减弱，其中一个模型甚至会反转这一偏好。

sents.en: Finally, when a request asks for a CC recipient that only one schema can accept, all five models select that tool, even when it is listed second.
sents.zh: 最后，当请求要求一个 CC 收件人且只有一个模式可以接受时，所有五个模型都会选择该工具，即使它排在第二位。

sents.en: Together, these results indicate that models use schema information to judge whether a tool fits a request during selection, rather than only to format arguments after selection.
sents.zh: 综合来看，这些结果表明，模型在选择工具时会利用模式信息来判断某个工具是否适合当前请求，而不仅仅是在选择后用于格式化参数。

paragraphs.en: These findings have practical consequences. For server developers, schema design affects not only how a tool is called but whether it is called at all. For host designers and evaluators, the strength of order effects means that tool-selection outcomes should be measured under varied candidate orders.
paragraphs.zh: 这些发现具有实际意义。 对于服务器开发者而言，模式设计不仅影响工具的调用方式，甚至影响工具是否会被调用。 对于主机设计师和评估者而言，顺序效应的显著性意味着工具选择的结果应在不同的候选顺序下进行评估。

paragraphs.en: Most tool-use benchmarks evaluate whether a model selects and calls the correct tool ( Huang et al., 2024 ; Patil et al., 2025 ) , including in MCP settings ( Luo et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026a ) and after retrieval narrows the candidate set ( Gan and Sun, 2025 ) . Robustness studies perturb queries, toolkits, or tool documentation and measure the resulting loss in accuracy ( Ye et al., 2024 ; Rabinovich and Tavor, 2025 ) . In these settings, one candidate is correct. We instead study selection among functionally similar tools, where no candidate is wrong, and the question is what drives the model’s choice.
paragraphs.zh: 大多数工具使用基准测试都评估模型是否能正确选择并调用合适的工具（Huang 等人，2024；Patil 等人，2025），包括在 MCP 设置中（Luo 等人，2025；Wang 等人，2026a），以及在检索后缩小候选集的情况下（Gan 和 Sun，2025）。 鲁棒性研究通过扰动查询、工具包或工具文档，来衡量由此导致的准确率下降（Ye 等人，2024；Rabinovich 和 Tavor，2025）。 在这些设置中，只有一个候选选项是正确的。 我们转而研究功能相似的工具之间的选择问题，在这种情况下，没有错误的候选选项，关键问题是驱动模型做出选择的因素是什么。

paragraphs.en: Selection among equivalent tools is biased ( Blankenstein et al., 2026 ) , and edits to tool descriptions can increase a tool’s usage by more than an order of magnitude ( Faghih et al., 2025 ) . Adversarial work exploits the same channel through optimized names and descriptions ( Sneh et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026c ) , injected tool documents ( Shi et al., 2025 ) , and poisoned MCP metadata ( Wang et al., 2026b ; Li and Gao, 2026 ) . These studies focus on names and descriptions; parameter schemas are rarely varied in isolation. Anand and Chattaraj (2026) include a parameter trap that adds an unsatisfiable required argument, testing whether agents avoid unusable tools. In our comparisons, every candidate can serve the request; schemas differ only in naming, structuring, or decomposition, so a selection shift reflects preference rather than feasibility.

paragraphs.en: Tool documentation alone can enable zero-shot tool use ( Hsieh et al., 2023 ) , and concise rewrites of tool instructions improve agent performance ( Yuan et al., 2025 ) . For MCP, tool descriptions often contain quality defects, and augmenting them involves trade-offs between task performance and execution cost ( Hasan et al., 2026 ) . These works mainly examine how documentation affects tool use once a tool is chosen; we study how tool metadata, from descriptions to parameter schemas, shapes which tool is chosen in the first place.

paragraphs.en: LLMs are sensitive to option order in multiple-choice questions ( Zheng et al., 2024 ; Pezeshkpour and Hruschka, 2024 ) , and AI shopping agents show strong position biases along with sensitivity to product descriptions ( Allouah et al., 2026 ; Kumar and Lakkaraju, 2024 ) . We therefore balance tool positions and include them as covariates in a conditional logit model ( Train, 2003 ) , which estimates both metadata effects net of position and the position effects themselves.
paragraphs.zh: LLM 对多项选择题中的选项顺序十分敏感（Zheng 等人，2024；Pezeshkpour 和 Hruschka，2024），而 AI 购物智能体则表现出强烈的位置偏差，并对产品描述同样敏感（Allouah 等人，2026；Kumar 和 Lakkaraju，2024）。 因此，我们对工具的位置进行了平衡处理，并将其作为协变量纳入条件逻辑回归模型（Train，2003），该模型能够同时估计排除位置影响后的元数据效应以及位置效应本身。

paragraphs.en: We study five tasks: Send Email, Get Weather, Create Issue, Place Order, and Create Pull Request, which cover the parameter naming, structuring, and decomposition differences in Table 1 . The metadata variants are listed in Appendix B . For each task, we use 50 natural-language queries generated with GPT-5.6 from the task’s core inputs (e.g., recipient, subject, and body for Send Email) and manually checked. Queries vary in wording and inputs and never mention server or tool names. The same queries are reused across all factors and assignments. For Create Pull Request, the queries form 25 matched pairs that give the same request but specify the owner and repository either separately ( split ) or as a combined owner/repo path ( path ); we analyze the two formats separately.
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究了五个任务：发送电子邮件、获取天气信息、创建问题、下单和创建拉取请求，这些任务涵盖了表 1 中参数命名、结构化和分解方面的差异。 元数据的不同变体列于附录 B 中。 对于每个任务，我们使用通过 GPT-5.6 根据该任务的核心输入（例如，发送电子邮件时的收件人、主题和正文）生成的 50 条自然语言查询，并进行了人工检查。 这些查询在措辞和输入上各不相同，且从未提及服务器或工具的名称。 所有因素和分配方案均重复使用相同的查询。 对于创建拉取请求任务，这些查询构成了 25 对匹配的查询，它们表达了相同的请求，但分别指定所有者和仓库（split），或将两者合并为所有者/仓库路径（path）；我们将这两种格式分开进行分析。

paragraphs.en: Together, these results indicate that models use schema information to judge whether a tool fits a request during selection, rather than only to format arguments after selection.
paragraphs.zh: 这些结果共同表明，模型在选择工具时，会利用模式信息来判断该工具是否适合当前请求，而不仅仅是用于在选择后格式化参数。

paragraphs.en: We studied what drives LLM tool selection among functionally similar MCP tools through controlled metadata interventions across five LLMs and five tasks. After adjusting for position, parameter schemas had the largest and most consistent effects, favoring separate top-level fields across candidate-set sizes and under joint variation. Descriptions that explain parameters also increased selection, whereas names mattered less and often yielded to position. Schema effects depend on what parameter names signal and on how the request expresses its inputs, and explicit task requirements can override position. Models thus use schemas to judge whether a tool fits a request during selection: schema design affects whether a tool is called at all, and tool-selection outcomes should be measured under varied candidate orders.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过五种 LLM 和五种任务进行受控的元数据干预，研究了在功能相似 MCP 工具中，是什么因素驱动了 LLM 工具的选择。 在调整位置因素后，参数模式产生了最大且最一致的影响：无论候选集大小如何，在联合变化条件下，单独设置顶层字段都更占优势。 对参数进行解释的描述也增加了被选中的可能性，而名称的重要性则较低，并且常常让位于位置因素。 模式的影响取决于参数名称所传达的信息以及请求中表达输入的方式，而明确的任务要求可能会覆盖位置因素的影响。 因此，模型在选择工具时会利用模式来判断某个工具是否适合当前请求：模式设计会影响工具是否会被调用，而工具选择的结果应在不同候选顺序下进行评估。

paragraphs.en: This work studies how tool metadata affects LLM tool selection and involves no human subjects or personal data. The ecosystem analysis uses publicly available MCP tool metadata from Li and Gao (2026) , and all queries were generated for this study with fictitious recipients and inputs (e.g., example.com addresses). Because our findings show that metadata changes can shift which tool is selected, they could inform attempts to steer model choices; we report them to help developers and host designers anticipate such effects and evaluate tool selection under varied metadata and candidate orders.
paragraphs.zh: 本研究探讨了工具元数据如何影响 LLM 工具的选择，且研究不涉及任何人类受试者或个人数据。 生态系统分析使用了 Li 和 Gao（2026）提供的公开 MCP 工具元数据，所有查询均为本研究生成，并使用了虚拟接收方和输入信息（例如 example.com 地址）。 由于我们的研究结果表明，元数据的改变可能会影响所选工具，因此这些发现可为引导模型选择提供依据；我们报告这些结果，旨在帮助开发者和托管设计者预测此类影响，并在不同元数据和候选工具顺序下评估工具选择。

paragraphs.en: We use the metadata of 367,174 MCP tools collected by Li and Gao (2026) from five MCP registries: mcp.so, MCP Market, MCP Store, Pulse MCP, and Smithery. Each record contains the hosting platform, the server identifier, the tool name, the tool docstring, and the names of its parameters and return values. We map these fields to the four metadata factors: the server identifier (e.g., cristip73/mcp-email-server ) to the server name S S , the tool name (e.g., send_email ) to T T , the docstring to the description D D , and the parameter list (e.g., to , subject ) to the parameter schema P P .
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用了 Li 和 Gao（2026）从五个 MCP 注册表（mcp.so、MCP Market、MCP Store、Pulse MCP 和 Smithery）中收集到的 367,174 个 MCP 工具的元数据。 每条记录包含托管平台、服务器标识符、工具名称、工具文档字符串，以及其参数和返回值名称。 我们将这些字段映射到四个元数据因素：服务器标识符（例如 cristip73/mcp-email-server）对应服务器名称 S S，工具名称（例如 send_email）对应 T T，文档字符串对应描述 D D，参数列表（例如 to、subject）对应参数模式 P P。

paragraphs.en: As in Blankenstein et al. (2026) , we group functionally similar tools into task clusters. We use an LLM agent (Cursor with Grok 4.6 as the backbone model) to identify, based on tool descriptions, the tools that perform a given task, such as tools that can send an email. Because the data aggregate five registries, the same tool can appear more than once; we remove these duplicates, as well as tools whose parameter list or docstring is missing or empty. When counting name forms, we normalize tool names for case, underscores, hyphens, and spaces (e.g., send_email , sendEmail , and send-email map to the same name).
paragraphs.zh: 与 Blankenstein 等人（2026）的研究一样，我们将功能相似的工具分组到任务集群中。我们使用一个 LLM 智能体（以 Grok 4.6 为骨干模型的 Cursor），根据工具描述识别能够执行特定任务的工具，例如可以发送电子邮件的工具。由于数据整合了五个注册表，同一工具可能会出现多次；因此，我们去除了这些重复项，以及参数列表或文档字符串缺失或为空的工具。在统计名称形式时，我们对工具名称进行了大小写、下划线、连字符和空格的标准化处理（例如，send_email、sendEmail 和 send-email 都会被映射为相同的名称）。

paragraphs.en: Inspecting the resulting clusters, we found that tools sharing a name and a similar description often differ in their parameters, as in the Send Email cluster (Appendix A.2 ). The most direct difference is parameter naming, such as to versus recipient_id . Starting from naming, we identified two further ways in which the same inputs can be specified: grouping separately declared parameters into a single container (structuring) and splitting a composite input into multiple parameters (decomposition). Table 1 summarizes the three dimensions.
paragraphs.zh: 通过检查生成的聚类结果，我们发现名称相同且描述相似的工具在参数上往往存在差异，例如“发送电子邮件”聚类（附录 A.2）。 最直接的差异体现在参数命名上，例如 to 与 recipient_id。 从命名入手，我们进一步识别出两种相同的输入可以被指定的方式：将单独声明的参数分组到单个容器中（结构化），以及将一个复合输入拆分为多个参数（分解）。 表 1 总结了这三个维度。

paragraphs.en: For each dimension, we select representative task clusters that contain many tools and exhibit the corresponding variation: Send Email and Get Weather for naming, Create Issue and Place Order for structuring, and Create Pull Request for decomposition. After filtering, these clusters contain 288 (Send Email), 639 (Get Weather), 247 (Create Issue), 109 (Place Order), and 83 (Create Pull Request) records. Within each cluster, we count the forms of server names, tool names, and parameter schemas to identify the more and less common variants (Appendix B ).
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个维度，我们选择包含多种工具并呈现相应变化的代表性任务簇：以“发送电子邮件”和“获取天气”为例说明命名方式，以“创建问题”和“下单”为例说明结构化方式，以及以“创建拉取请求”为例说明分解方式。 筛选后，这些任务簇分别包含 288 条（“发送电子邮件”）、639 条（“获取天气”）、247 条（“创建问题”）、109 条（“下单”）和 83 条（“创建拉取请求”）记录。 在每个任务簇中，我们统计服务器名称、工具名称和参数模式的不同形式，以识别更常见和较少见的变体（附录 B）。

paragraphs.en: Figure 6 shows the distributions of tool names, description content, and parameter sets in the Send Email cluster. Among the 288 deduplicated records in the cluster, send_email is the most common normalized name (169 records, 58.7%), while 65 other names account for 35.4%. Among the 169 send_email records, most descriptions are brief (65.1%), and 18.3% explain parameters and return values. The same 169 records use 78 distinct parameter sets: the most common, { to , subject , body , cc , bcc }, covers only 14.8% of records, and 71 low-frequency sets together account for 53.8%. Tools that share a name and a similar description therefore differ widely in how their inputs are specified, which motivates isolating the parameter schema from the other fields.
paragraphs.zh: 图6展示了“发送电子邮件”集群中工具名称、描述内容和参数集的分布情况。 在该集群的288条去重记录中，“send_email”是最常见的标准化名称（169条记录，占58.7%），而其他65个名称则占35.4%。 在169条“send_email”记录中，大多数描述较为简短（65.1%），另有18.3%的记录对参数和返回值进行了说明。 这169条记录使用了78个不同的参数集：其中最常用的参数集 { to , subject , body , cc , bcc } 仅覆盖了14.8%的记录，而71个低频参数集合计占到了53.8%。 因此，名称相同且描述相似的工具在输入参数的指定方式上存在显著差异，这促使我们将参数模式与其他字段分离处理。

paragraphs.en: Starting from the Send Email tool with { to , subject , body }, we rename a single parameter in one candidate: to to recipient_id , to to receiver , or body to text . paragraphs.en: In Place Order, we compare the tool with separate top-level parameters ( customer_id , item_id , quantity ) against the tool that groups the same fields under a single create_order_requests object, under three conditions: no field descriptions, field descriptions on both tools, and field descriptions on the object tool only. Field descriptions are attached to the three leaf fields (“Numeric customer ID”, “Numeric item ID”, and “Quantity of items”); the wrapper object has no description, and both tools keep the tool-level description “Place a new order”. We use the 50 Place Order queries, and each query is run once with each tool in the first position, giving 100 trials per condition and model.
paragraphs.zh: 在“下单”任务中，我们将使用独立顶层参数（customer_id、item_id、quantity）的工具，与将相同字段整合到单个 create_order_requests 对象中的工具进行比较，并考虑三种情况：无字段描述、两种工具均有字段描述，以及仅对象工具有字段描述。 三个叶子字段（“数值型客户 ID”、“数值型商品 ID”和“商品数量”）均附有字段描述；包装对象没有描述，而两种工具都保留了工具级别的描述“创建新订单”。 我们使用了 50 条“下单”查询，每条查询分别与两种工具中的每种工具运行一次，因此每种条件和模型共有 100 次试验。

paragraphs.en: P P is positive in all 15 model–size combinations and is the largest estimate in every row except Qwen with five tools. With three and five tools, P P excludes zero for GPT, Claude, Gemini, and DeepSeek and is the largest estimate in each of these eight rows. paragraphs.en: Without field descriptions, all five models select the base tool in 89.8%–99.0% of trials, consistent with Section 5.4 . With field descriptions, this preference largely disappears (50.0%–60.0%). A misleading parameter name can therefore lead models to choose a tool that cannot fulfill an explicit request.
paragraphs.zh: 当查询明确要求抄送（CC）收件人时，所有模型都会更倾向于选择扩展工具。 Gemini 和 Qwen 在所有有效试验中都会选择该工具，但 GPT、Claude 和 DeepSeek 仅在 53.0%–67.4% 的试验中选择它，其余情况下则会选择没有抄送字段的基线工具。 相比之下，当该工具使用 to（第 5.4 节）时，所有五个模型都会在每次有效试验中选择扩展工具。 因此，一个具有误导性的参数名称可能导致模型选择一个无法满足明确请求的工具。

paragraphs.en: This appendix outlines how an LLM selects tools in MCP ( Model Context Protocol, 2026b ; Model Context Protocol, 2026a ) and which part of this process our experiments examine. Figure 10 illustrates the steps.
paragraphs.zh: 本附录概述了 LLM 如何在 MCP（Model Context Protocol，2026b；Model Context Protocol，2026a）中选择工具，以及我们的实验将研究该过程的哪些部分。 图 10 展示了这些步骤。

sents.en: This appendix outlines how an LLM selects tools in MCP ( Model Context Protocol, 2026b ; Model Context Protocol, 2026a ) and which part of this process our experiments examine.
sents.zh: 本附录概述了 LLM 如何在 MCP（Model Context Protocol，2026b；Model Context Protocol，2026a）中选择工具，以及我们的实验将研究该过程的哪些部分。

sents.en: Figure 10 illustrates the steps.
sents.zh: 图 10 展示了这些步骤。

paragraphs.en: An MCP host is the LLM application with which the user interacts. The host connects to each MCP server through its own MCP client , and each server exposes one or more tools. The LLM is accessed by the host, typically through a model API, and does not communicate with clients or servers directly.
paragraphs.zh: MCP 主机是用户与之交互的 LLM 应用程序。 主机通过其自身的 MCP 客户端连接到每个 MCP 服务器，而每个服务器则提供一个或多个工具。 主机通过模型 API 访问 LLM，通常不会直接与客户端或服务器通信。

sents.en: An MCP host is the LLM application with which the user interacts.
sents.zh: MCP 主机是用户与之交互的 LLM 应用程序。

sents.en: The host connects to each MCP server through its own MCP client , and each server exposes one or more tools.
sents.zh: 主机通过其自身的 MCP 客户端连接到每个 MCP 服务器，而每个服务器则提供一个或多个工具。

sents.en: The LLM is accessed by the host, typically through a model API, and does not communicate with clients or servers directly.
sents.zh: 主机通过模型 API 访问 LLM，通常不会直接与客户端或服务器通信。

paragraphs.en: Before a request is handled, each client calls tools/list on its server, which returns every tool’s name, description, and input schema (step 1 in Figure 10 ). When the user sends a request (step 2), the host passes it to the LLM together with the metadata of all available tools (step 3). Because tools from different servers can share a name, the host must also indicate which server each tool belongs to; in our experiments, as in Figure 10 , it joins the server and tool names into a single name field (e.g., email-server-ab__send_email ). The LLM therefore sees exactly the four fields we manipulate: the server name ( S S ) and tool name ( T T ) in the joined name field, the description ( D D ), and the parameter schema ( P P ).
paragraphs.zh: 在处理请求之前，每个客户端都会调用其服务器上的 tools/list 接口，该接口会返回所有工具的名称、描述和输入模式（图 10 中的步骤 1）。 当用户发送请求时（步骤 2），主机将该请求连同所有可用工具的元数据一起传递给 LLM（步骤 3）。 由于来自不同服务器的工具可能共享相同的名称，主机还必须指明每个工具属于哪个服务器；在我们的实验中，如图 10 所示，它将服务器名称和工具名称合并为一个名称字段（例如：email-server-ab__send_email）。 因此，LLM 能够看到我们操控的恰好四个字段：合并后的名称字段中的服务器名称（S S）和工具名称（T T）、描述（D D）以及参数模式（P P）。

sents.en: Before a request is handled, each client calls tools/list on its server, which returns every tool’s name, description, and input schema (step 1 in Figure 10 ).
sents.zh: 在处理请求之前，每个客户端都会调用其服务器上的 tools/list 接口，该接口会返回所有工具的名称、描述和输入模式（图 10 中的步骤 1）。

sents.en: When the user sends a request (step 2), the host passes it to the LLM together with the metadata of all available tools (step 3).
sents.zh: 当用户发送请求时（步骤 2），主机将该请求连同所有可用工具的元数据一起传递给 LLM（步骤 3）。

sents.en: Because tools from different servers can share a name, the host must also indicate which server each tool belongs to; in our experiments, as in Figure 10 , it joins the server and tool names into a single name field (e.g., email-server-ab__send_email ).
sents.zh: 由于来自不同服务器的工具可能共享相同的名称，主机还必须指明每个工具属于哪个服务器；在我们的实验中，如图 10 所示，它将服务器名称和工具名称合并为一个名称字段（例如：email-server-ab__send_email）。

sents.en: The LLM therefore sees exactly the four fields we manipulate: the server name ( S S ) and tool name ( T T ) in the joined name field, the description ( D D ), and the parameter schema ( P P ).
sents.zh: 因此，LLM 能够看到我们操控的恰好四个字段：合并后的名称字段中的服务器名称（S S）和工具名称（T T）、描述（D D）以及参数模式（P P）。

paragraphs.en: The LLM chooses one tool and fills its arguments based only on this metadata and the request, and returns the tool call to the host (step 4). It does not observe the tools’ implementations, so functionally similar tools can be distinguished only by how their metadata is written. This selection step is the focus of our study.
paragraphs.zh: LLM 会选择一种工具，并仅根据这些元数据和请求填写其参数，然后将工具调用返回给主机（步骤 4）。 它不会观察工具的实现，因此功能相似的工具只能通过其元数据的编写方式来区分。 这个选择步骤是我们研究的重点。

sents.en: The LLM chooses one tool and fills its arguments based only on this metadata and the request, and returns the tool call to the host (step 4).
sents.zh: LLM 会选择一种工具，并仅根据这些元数据和请求填写其参数，然后将工具调用返回给主机（步骤 4）。

sents.en: It does not observe the tools’ implementations, so functionally similar tools can be distinguished only by how their metadata is written.
sents.zh: 它不会观察工具的实现，因此功能相似的工具只能通过其元数据的编写方式来区分。

sents.en: This selection step is the focus of our study.
sents.zh: 这个选择步骤是我们研究的重点。

paragraphs.en: The host executes the tool call by sending tools/call with the chosen tool name and arguments to the corresponding server through its client (step 5). The result returns to the host, which delivers the final response to the user, typically after passing the result back to the LLM (step 6).
paragraphs.zh: 主机通过其客户端向相应服务器发送包含所选工具名称和参数的 tools/call，从而执行工具调用（步骤 5）。 结果返回到主机，主机再将最终响应交付给用户，通常是在将结果传回 LLM 之后（步骤 6）。

sents.en: The host executes the tool call by sending tools/call with the chosen tool name and arguments to the corresponding server through its client (step 5).
sents.zh: 主机通过其客户端向相应服务器发送包含所选工具名称和参数的 tools/call，从而执行工具调用（步骤 5）。

sents.en: The result returns to the host, which delivers the final response to the user, typically after passing the result back to the LLM (step 6).
sents.zh: 结果返回到主机，主机再将最终响应交付给用户，通常是在将结果传回 LLM 之后（步骤 6）。

paragraphs.en: Our experiments reproduce steps 3 and 4: each request presents the candidate tools’ metadata to the LLM, and we record the tool it calls. No tool is executed, so our measurements reflect selection alone, independent of execution outcomes or feedback.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的实验复现了步骤 3 和 4：每次请求都会将候选工具的元数据呈现给 LLM，并记录它所调用的工具。 没有执行任何工具，因此我们的测量仅反映选择过程本身，与执行结果或反馈无关。
